segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין לוֹקְחִין בָּתִּים עֲבָדִים וּבְהֵמָה אֶלָּא לְצוֹרֶךְ הַמּוֹעֵד, אוֹ לְצוֹרֶךְ הַמּוֹכֵר שֶׁאֵין לוֹ מַה יֹּאכַל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One may not purchase houses, slaves, and cattle» on the intermediate days of a Festival «unless» it is «for the sake of the Festival, or» to provide «for the needs of the seller who does not have anything to eat.»

moves.summary: Purchases only for the Festival or a needy seller

positions.claim: only for Festival needs or for a seller who has nothing to eat
